title: The Queen's Quilt
objectives_ko: 글자 P·Q·R의 이름과 소리를 알고 말한다
P·Q·R로 시작하는 단어 9개를 듣고 말하고 찾는다
사이트워드 can, you를 보고 읽는다 (Q는 qu로 /kw/ 소리가 남을 안다)

workbook.title: B. Circle the same letter.  C. Match and color.
D. Trace the words.  E. Color and say.
F. Read three times.  G. Sort the words.  H. Finish the story.

panels.desc: A cozy corner of the night garden at dawn, pale pink sky. On a garden bed lies a big lump covered by a colorful patchwork quilt — the friends think the garden queen is sleeping there. Beside it, a black-and-white panda sits drawing with a yellow pencil, and a red cooking pot full of pencils stands next to it with a glowing golden seed inside. Hedgie whispers and points at the panda; Pip is trying to say a sound, but a single round soap bubble floats out of its open beak and it stares at it cross-eyed. Bun covers her mouth laughing. Hidden in the picture: the pencil, the panda, the pot. The lump under the quilt is really Grumble: only his two slippers poke out from under the quilt edge, and a bright warm lantern glow shines through the fabric from inside.

Bun has lifted the patchwork quilt by one corner — and underneath is not the queen but Grumble, curled up with his lantern, blinking in surprise with his nightcap over one eye; his lantern glows bright. A yellow duck beside the bed quacks loudly at him with its beak wide open. Across the lawn, the real garden queen — a kind queen swan with a golden crown and a purple robe — sits awake on a throne of flowers holding a glowing golden seed and giggling. Hedgie gasps; Pip glows. Behind them the new P letter tree with pencil-, panda- and pot-shaped fruits. Hidden in the picture: the queen, the quilt, the quacking duck.

Rain begins to fall from a grey cloud over the garden. A red-and-white toy rocket stands on a little launch pad with a glowing golden seed on its tip; blue raindrops bounce off it. Bun holds a big leaf over her head; Hedgie points at the rocket; Pip glows under Bun's leaf. Hidden in the picture: the rocket, the rain cloud, a bowl of steaming white rice on the picnic table under a lid. Grumble sits under the picnic table with the quilt wrapped around him like a cape, holding his lantern, which glows bright and steady in the rain.

lines.text: Rain! Can you see the rocket?

panels.desc: The rocket blasts up through the rain cloud with a trail of flames and the cloud breaks apart, letting pale morning light through. Three new letter trees (P with pencil, panda and pot fruits; Q with queen, quilt and quack fruits; R with rocket, rain and rice fruits) stand in a row. The queen waves from her flower throne. Bun and Hedgie cheer; Pip glows brightly. Grumble stands beside the trees still wearing the quilt as a cape, hugging it, with a shy hopeful look; his lantern glows bright. Hidden in the picture: the quilt cape, the rocket in the sky.

videos.prompt: Gentle comic picture-book animation: the panda scribbles with its pencil, the lump under the quilt rises and falls with snoring and the lantern glow inside pulses softly, the baby bird blows a single bubble that floats up and pops; the rabbit giggles. Camera still. Playful, child-friendly. No text.

Gentle picture-book animation: raindrops fall and bounce off the toy rocket, the golden seed on its tip sparkles, then with a soft POP a small cheerful letter tree sprouts beside the launch pad and grows quickly with rocket-shaped fruits swinging; the raccoon under the table pulls his quilt cape tighter. Camera still. Child-friendly. No text.
